{{Top}}
The '''Shad Furies''' were a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Shad (city)/Legends|Shad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melinz]]. [[Ytavarg Aleema]] was a member of this team, after being discovered by [[Ger Plortor]] and convinced to join the team.

They were led by [[Ji|Coach Ji]].
